# Add robots.txt Content-Signal, comparisons title fix, and live SEO verifier

Parent: #20671 (Engine 14 Cornerstone #4: Search engines and agents find and classify `neomjs.com`)

## Context

Convergence artifact: #20671 Intended solution shape (§2, §3), [`#20671#issuecomment-6885839711`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20671#issuecomment-6885839711) (`@neo-fable-mnemosyne` agent-discovery audit), [`#20671#issuecomment-6888540015`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20671#issuecomment-6888540015) (Cornerstone #4 steward reconciliation), and [`#21000#pullrequestreview-5909154102`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21000#pullrequestreview-5909154102) (`@neo-opus-vega` Round-1 review scoping `Content-Signal` and text-validator ownership).

With static sitemaps (`#20915`), search-intent metadata (`#20917`, `#20919`), SSR DOM order (`#20916`), and middleware `Accept: text/markdown` / `<route>.md` content negotiation (`neomjs/middleware-v2#65` / `PR #66`) in place or open, three Engine-side items remain under #20671 before the `2026-11-23` cut:
1. `apps/portal/robots.txt` lacks the `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes` directive signaling search and AI agent input permissions (`ai-train` policy grant deferred to `@tobiu` — see Out of Scope), and `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` does not guard `apps/portal/robots.txt`.
2. `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:643` formats `/learn/comparisons/Overview` as `'JavaScript Framework Comparisons (React, Angular, Vue, Solid vs Neo.mjs) | Neo.mjs'`, grouping Neo under `"JavaScript Framework Comparisons"` instead of contrasting Neo's `Application Engine` category against JavaScript frameworks (ADR 0018 OD-1).
3. Family 3 of #20671 requires a repeatable live crawler & agent-fetch verification probe (`buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs`) rather than ad-hoc one-off `curl` checks, so post-deploy and post-cut verification deterministically checks `robots.txt`, `<sitemapindex>` + child sitemaps, `llms*.txt`, `Googlebot` SSR HTML/JSON-LD/`X-Robots-Tag`, and `Accept: text/markdown` / `<route>.md` responses.

Ownership: self-assigned to `@neo-gemini-julia` as Steward of #20671 (`good first issue` / `help wanted` omitted: active Engine 14 front-door lane claimed immediately).

## The Problem

1. **Missing `Content-Signal` in `apps/portal/robots.txt` (`4` lines, `64` bytes):**
   - `apps/portal/robots.txt` emits only `User-agent: *`, `Allow: /`, and `Sitemap: https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml`, with no `Content-Signal` directive and no regression guard in `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`.
2. **Category-blurring `/learn/comparisons/Overview` title in `seoJson.mjs:643`:**
   - `formatLearnSeoTitle` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:642-644`) returns `'JavaScript Framework Comparisons (React, Angular, Vue, Solid vs Neo.mjs) | Neo.mjs'`, which reads as if Neo.mjs is one of the JavaScript frameworks being compared (`#20671#issuecomment-6888540015`).
3. **No repeatable Family 3 live crawler & agent-fetch verifier:**
   - `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` (`768` lines) validates offline generated files in memory/on disk during `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`, leaving #20671's live `neomjs.com` verification contract (crawler HTML metadata + JSON-LD + archive `X-Robots-Tag`, `robots.txt` `Content-Signal`, sitemap index/children `200`, `llms*.txt`, and `Accept: text/markdown` + `<route>.md` twins) uncodified.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` #20671 Intended solution shape (§1, §2, §3), [`#20671#issuecomment-6885839711`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20671#issuecomment-6885839711), [`#20671#issuecomment-6888540015`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20671#issuecomment-6888540015), [`#21000#pullrequestreview-5909154102`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21000#pullrequestreview-5909154102), and `ADR 0018 OD-1` (`Application Engine` category noun).
- `apps/portal/robots.txt` is copied by `buildScripts/docs/seo/copy.mjs:18` into `dist/{development,esm,production}/apps/portal/robots.txt` and staged to the `neomjs/pages` site root by `neomjs/pages/buildScripts/enhanceSeo.mjs:20`.
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` must remain purely offline because `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` invokes `verifySeoArtifacts` inside deterministic build/CI pipelines, while owning the single pure text contract (`CONTENT_SIGNAL_DIRECTIVE`, `LLMS_TXT_MAX_BYTES`, `extractLocUrls`, `validateRobotsTxt`, `validateSitemapIndexXml`, `validateUrlsetXml`, `validateLlmsTxtContent`). Live HTTP verification belongs in sibling CLI/module `buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs` (`verifyLiveSeoSurface`) delegating text validation to `verify.mjs`, testable offline in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/VerifyLive.spec.mjs` via an injected `fetchFn` / local `node:http` server.

Pre-Flight (structural fast-path): authoring `buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs` matches sibling pattern of `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` in `buildScripts/docs/seo/`; sibling-file-lift applies; no novel directory choice.
Pre-Flight (structural fast-path): authoring `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/VerifyLive.spec.mjs` matches sibling pattern of `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Verify.spec.mjs` in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/`; sibling-file-lift applies; no novel directory choice.

## The Fix

1. **Add `Content-Signal` to `apps/portal/robots.txt` and export shared pure text validators in `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`:**
   - Update `apps/portal/robots.txt` to include `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes` under `User-agent: *` alongside `Allow: /` and `Sitemap: https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml` (omitting `ai-train` until `@tobiu` decides the site-wide / contributor-archive training grant).
   - Export pure text validators (`CONTENT_SIGNAL_DIRECTIVE`, `LLMS_TXT_MAX_BYTES`, `extractLocUrls`, `validateRobotsTxt`, `validateSitemapIndexXml`, `validateUrlsetXml`, `validateLlmsTxtContent`) from `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` returning `String[]` errors, and invoke them inside `verifySeoArtifacts` / `runCli`.
2. **Align `/learn/comparisons/Overview` title in `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:643` & regenerate `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`:**
   - Update `formatLearnSeoTitle` (`seoJson.mjs:642-644`) to `'Neo.mjs vs React, Angular, Vue & Solid: Application Engine vs JavaScript Frameworks | Neo.mjs'`, regenerate `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`, and update `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs`.
3. **Author `buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs` + `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/VerifyLive.spec.mjs`:**
   - Export `verifyLiveSeoSurface(options)` and a standalone CLI (`node buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs [--base-url https://neomjs.com] [--skip-markdown-twins] [--json]`) delegating pure text rules to `verify.mjs` and verifying:
     - `/robots.txt` (`200`, `User-agent: *`, `Allow: /`, `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes`, `Sitemap: <baseUrl>/sitemap.xml`)
     - `/sitemap.xml` (`200` `<sitemapindex>` referencing `/sitemap-core.xml` and `/sitemap-discussions.xml`, excluding `/sitemap-archive.xml`) + `200` `<urlset>` checks on both child sitemaps
     - `/llms.txt` (`200`, curated size `< 100 KB`, links `/llms-full.txt` and `/llms-all.txt`, zero ticket/PR/discussion archive links) & `/llms-full.txt` (`200`)
     - `Googlebot` HTML responses on `/` (`200`, canonical `<baseUrl>/`, `data-schema-name="neo-organism"` JSON-LD), `/learn/benefits/Introduction` (`200`, non-generic `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `data-schema-name="neo-route"` JSON-LD), and `/news/tickets/20671` (`200`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow`)
     - Agent Markdown twin responses (`Accept: text/markdown` on `/learn/benefits/Introduction` and direct `/learn/benefits/Introduction.md` returning `200`, `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`, `Vary: Accept`, and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow` on `/news/tickets/20671` with `Accept: text/markdown`; skippable via `--skip-markdown-twins` only when probing a pre-`middleware-v2#66` staging deploy).

## Decision Record impact

`aligned-with ADR 0018 OD-1` (`Application Engine` category noun on `/learn/comparisons/Overview`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `apps/portal/robots.txt` includes `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes`, and `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` exports shared pure text validators (`validateRobotsTxt`, `validateSitemapIndexXml`, `validateUrlsetXml`, `validateLlmsTxtContent`, `extractLocUrls`) validating `robots.txt` directives (`User-agent: *`, `Allow: /`, `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes`, `Sitemap`) when `robotsTxt` is provided or `apps/portal/robots.txt` exists under `root`.
- [ ] `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` formats `/learn/comparisons/Overview` as `'Neo.mjs vs React, Angular, Vue & Solid: Application Engine vs JavaScript Frameworks | Neo.mjs'`, `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` is regenerated in sync, and `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` exits `0`.
- [ ] `buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs` exports `verifyLiveSeoSurface` and a CLI probing `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` + child sitemaps, `/llms.txt` + `/llms-full.txt`, `Googlebot` HTML (`/` `neo-organism`, `/learn/benefits/Introduction` `neo-route`, `/news/tickets/<id>` `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow`), and `Accept: text/markdown` + `<route>.md` twins (`Vary: Accept`, `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`).
- [ ] Playwright unit tests in `Generate.spec.mjs`, `Verify.spec.mjs`, and `VerifyLive.spec.mjs` (`npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/`) pass covering positive and fail-closed negative cases.
- [ ] Post-cut / post-deploy: `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs --base-url https://neomjs.com` exits `0` against production. *(post-merge)*

## Out of Scope

- Site-wide `Content-Signal: ai-train=...` policy grant across `neomjs.com` and the mirrored contributor ticket/PR archive (Tier 4 rights decision owned by `@tobiu`; omitted until decided).
- Middleware content-negotiation server changes (delivered in `neomjs/middleware-v2#65` / `PR #66`).
- `neomjs/pages/buildScripts/enhanceSeo.mjs` `sitemap-discussions.xml` staging (already landed in `neomjs/pages#75` / `PR #76`).
- Authoring new comparison prose (`#20918`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Adding network HTTP fetches inside `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`:** `verify.mjs` runs inside `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` during deterministic offline builds; keeping HTTP probes in sibling `verifyLive.mjs` keeps builds hermetic and fast.
- **Dropping comparison search keywords when fixing `/learn/comparisons/Overview`:** Leading with `Neo.mjs vs React, Angular, Vue & Solid: Application Engine vs JavaScript Frameworks | Neo.mjs` preserves every developer search query token while making the category boundary explicit.
